_comment: What this bundle ships and which gates it can decide by itself. kind 'scan' means a script here answers it; kind 'suite' means the bundle names the rule but the project has to write its own test — those are reported as pending, never as passed. The catalogue of suite rules arrives at the registry handover; see the extraction stages in README.md.

actions-sha-pinned.title: Every action in a workflow is pinned to a commit SHA

adr-index-complete.title: The ADR index covers every record, numbered without gaps

ci-tools-hash-pinned.title: Tools CI installs for itself are pinned by hash

csp-no-inline.title: Templates carry no inline handler, style, or script

delete-means-soft-delete.title: A real delete lives only in the declared purge modules

image-digest-pinned.title: A base image is pinned by digest, not only by tag

logic-knows-no-http.title: The service layer imports nothing from the request side

no-debug-entrypoint.title: An entrypoint cannot open a debug console, even run wrongly
